Application.Name: Audio Monitor
Application.Comment: This is an outdated release of the Monitoring Collection. Please update to the newest version to see additional release information.

Comment.Text: Release notes for version 1.11.0.0
This is a major release of Audio Monitor to improve usability and performance inclusive application stabilization for certain exceptional cases.

The main focus over the past few weeks has been on replacing APIs that are no longer supported by Windows or have become obsolete with new, native functions; providing the best possible support for the upcoming Windows release 26H2; and fixing bugs and addressing security-related issues.

Should you still encounter any problems with this release, please use as always the feedback or crash form to provide information. You are also welcome to take the opportunity to give feedback on usage, ideas for future releases or other helpful hints for a smooth user experience.

The complete tool collection can be used at no costs, only some premium feature requires a registration for free. Please remember that I do not earn any income from its use. However, you can support me by donating so that I can provide high quality releases this year again. Even if you cannot provide financial support, you can help spread the software and increase its visibility by sharing it.
